question: The first sounding rocket, Nike -Apache was launched by India in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**1963**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The launch of Tumba's first sounding rocket near **Thiruvananthapuram**,
 
• Kerala on **November 21, 1963 **marked the beginning of India's space program.
 
• Coordinated campaigns can be conducted by launching sounding rockets from different locations at the same time.
 
• It is also possible to launch multiple sounding rockets per day. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Sounding rockets are single- or double-stage solid-fuel rockets used for observation of the upper atmospheric region and space exploration.
 
• It also serves as an **affordable platform** for testing and prototyping new components and subsystems for use in rockets and satellites.
 
• In** 1963**, with the **Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station (TERLS)** at Thumba, a location close to the **magnetic equator,** a breakthrough was made in the field of Indian aeronautics and atmospheric sciences.
